scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.app:dev: lsof -ti tcp:8788 | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; CRUX_PORT=8788 VITE_CRUX_PORT=8788 CRUX_HOME=$HOME/.crux-dev tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.json
scripts.app:fresh: lsof -ti tcp:8789 | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; rm -rf ~/Library/WebKit/com.giraffe360.crux.fresh ~/Library/Caches/com.giraffe360.crux.fresh; CRUX_FRESH=1 VITE_CRUX_FRESH=1 CRUX_HOME=$(mktemp -d -t crux-fresh) CRUX_PORT=8789 VITE_CRUX_PORT=8789 tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.fresh.json
